manual.chemical_thrower.line2: The Chemical Thrower is a device that propels fluids and optionally ignites from its internal tanks.{0}
manual.chemical_thrower.line3: The device can be loaded with any fluid, liquid or gas, and, on right click, will spray it out.{0}
manual.chemical_thrower.line4: To toggle the pilot light for the ignition of flammable fluids, sneak and right-click.{0}
manual.chemical_thrower.line5: Like some other tools, the chemical thrower can be modified in the {0}Engineer's Workbench{1}. These upgrades affect the size of the tank, range and spread and are described on the following pages.{2}
manual.chemical_thrower.line6: {0}The §2Large Tank§r increases the fluid capacity of the Chemical Thrower by 2000 mb.
manual.chemical_thrower.line7: {0}The §2Focused Nozzle§r decreases the spread of fluids sprayed out and also slightly increases their range, allowing you to hit further targets with more precision.
manual.chemical_thrower.line8: {0}The §2Multitank§r allows the Chemthrower to store up to three different Fluids. You can select the active tank by {1}sneaking and using the scrollwheel, or through use of{2}using{3} the keybind §l{4}§r if it has been set in the options.
manual.chemical_thrower.line9: This upgrade is mutually exclusive to the §2Large Tank§r.
